description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Login' that renders a login modal form with email and password inputs, handles user input and login submission, and manages error display. It also includes icons and styling related to login UI.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: React functional component that renders login modal, manages email and password state, handles form submission, and displays errors.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Asynchronous function triggered on form submit; prevents default submission, clears previous errors, calls 'onLogin' prop with email and password, and sets error message on failure.
